scientific_integrity: The analytic reconstruction is self-contained; finite exact computations are corroborative, not exhaustive proof. Prior loop-jump and local metric-graph distribution results are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only connected finite one-junction metric graphs with at least one actual circle, positive edge lengths, uniform arclength sampling, and exact distance distributions; finite noisy-data stability not analyzed.
title: Global distance-distribution reconstruction of metric roses with pendant edges
